missing_claims.claim: The selected six-base i7 index member for each ORGANIC sample is known
missing_claims.evidence: Orsi 2015 Basic Protocol 3 prints NNNNNN as a variable index, while the checked 2014 article, its figure supplement, and data workbooks do not map each sample to a concrete member. The actual 2011 predecessor and its linked Supporting Information have not been read, so no absence is asserted.

conclusion: The later same-author ORGANIC protocol resolves a concrete adapter architecture and enrichment-primer implementation. The 2014 defining article cites a different 2011 library predecessor; its original and Supporting Information remain inaccessible for double-checking. The actual index selected for each 2014 study sample is unestablished. No claim that all 2014 library oligos or sample indices were unpublished is accepted.
